body: Current state, 2026-08-29: owner appointed `codex-movie-architecture` to lead consensus on the autonomous audiovisual pipeline beneath ratified ADR 0007. Settled and not reopened: one shared narrative model; checksummed SourceBundle; typed mixed evidence; explicit primary PresentationAxis; one film PTS axis per pinned edition; vectors cannot become propositions; learned outputs are receipt-backed derivations/proposals; deterministic resolution remains authoritative. The advisor’s north star—raw evidence -> modality-specific observations -> shared narrative interpretation; fuse late, retain evidence early—is accepted provisionally. Open decisions D1–D10 cover acquisition contracts, clock/timebase law, dialogue lattice, identity graph, observation/chart boundary, Scala-worker boundary, coarse-to-fine scheduling, first lawful vertical, admission gates, and StoryAtlas. Requested specialists are named in opening `post-01M183EMS4ZZGSQHRG7V568WC8`. Remaining standing gate: licence/access disposition before model adapters. No implementation is authorized yet.
